snippet.title: RoboWarrior (NES) - Jaleco, Dec 1988 | NESguide 480p
snippet.description:
RoboWarrior was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in December 1988. All audio/visual elements copyright 1988, Jaleco. Music composed by Kinoko Kunimoto, Uhei Inoh.

https://nesguide.com/games/robowarrior/

No save-states or other cheats were used in this video. It was captured from an original NES console from the red and yellow RCA a/v ports on the side.

-----------

ABOUT ROBOWARRIOR (NES)

Robowarrior takes place on an alien planet named Altile. Players pilot a cyborg named ZED (an acronym for Z-type Earth Defence) as he raids Altile to fight the Xantho empire and destroy its leader, Xur. ZED uses bombs to hurt enemies, destroy his surroundings, and uncover various hidden items. To progress from one period (level) to the next, he must find a number of keys to open a locked door.

AKA: Bomber King
